title: Multicenter study on respiratory viruses: immune response and evolution in NRW
summary: Respiratory viruses are viruses that infect the airways, including coronaviruses, influenza viruses, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). To advance research in this field, this study aims to investigate the body's immune response following viral infections of the upper and lower respiratory tract. Simultaneously, the study will examine viral changes (evolution). The body's immune response and the emergence of new viruses may require adjustments in prevention and treatment strategies.

interventions.name:
- Patients with acute infections from influenza, coronaviruses, or RSV will be asked to provide blood samples and nasopharyngeal swabs.  
- Patients will be asked to complete a questionnaire about their habits and health status.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Study participants are patients of the university hospital where the participant is recruited.
- According to medical opinion, the information and the additional biomaterial sampling do not represent an additional burden for the study participants.
- Ability to consent and agreement to participate in the study.
- An infection with coronavirus, influenza or RSV was diagnosed by PCR or POCT testing. (index patients) /no infection (control patients).
Exclusion criteria:
- Missing capacity to consent
- no consent to the study
- < 18 years
